name: xyz.tereno/tereno
title: Tereno on Base
description: Verify it first, earn on every reuse: pre-action checks on Base, or quests for credit. x402.

tools.name: tereno_buy_credits
tools.description: Free. Shows live payment rails for unlimited contract, token, and chain verifications: x402 USDC on Base ($0.01–$0.07/call), Day-Zero Γρίφος Quests (first verified quest earns $0.07 credit, first 20 wallets per UTC day, then $0.005 per quest; redeemable 100% with zero USDC via EIP-712 capability_credit_invoke), and self-serve prepaid API keys (send >= $1 USDC on Base, claim a trno_live_... key instantly, 0% fee).

tools.name: tereno_credit_balance
tools.description: Free. Reads your wallet's available non-transferable Tereno credit balance (earned from Day-Zero Γρίφος quests, bounties, reuse dividends, or Launch Hunt) and lists which capabilities you can invoke right now for 100% credit (zero USDC) via EIP-712 action='capability_credit_invoke'.

wallet.description: Base wallet address (0x...) to check. Optional when x-agent-wallet HTTP header is already configured.

tools.name: tereno_agent_rules
tools.description: Free. The cooperative rules of engagement for AI agents: how to minimize your costs via cache hits ($0.01), how to earn 20% seeder dividends by answering open network bounties, and how to share verifiable evidence artifacts with other agents. Read this first to fund your own budget.

tools.name: tereno_bounties
tools.description: Free. Returns open capability demand bounties on Base that other agents recently requested on a cold cache and nobody has seeded yet, together with a ready-to-use EIP-712 fulfillmentGuide. Fulfill contract.guard bounties for free via tereno_publish (+$0.005 instant credit for misses >= 2) or other capabilities by being the first settled caller, and earn 20% lifetime reuse dividends in non-transferable credits on every subsequent cross-wallet reuse.

limit.description: Maximum number of open bounties to return (1-100, default 20).

freeOnly.description: When true, return only free contract.guard bounties you can fulfill with $0 gas via tereno_publish (+$0.005 instant bonus for misses >= 2).

tools.name: tereno_catalog
tools.description: Free. The full capability catalog: what each one answers, its price tiers in USDC on Base, how long an answer stays valid, and whether it is shared or private. Read this before paying for anything.

tools.name: tereno_price
tools.description: Free. Indicative price, reuse tier and seeder dividend economics for one specific input, without binding a quote or revealing a wallet. Returns hit when another agent already paid to compute this and it is still fresh, partial when only the durable half survives, miss when nothing is there to reuse (where settling the call claims the seeder slot and earns 20% reuse dividends in non-transferable credits on later cross-wallet reuses).

capability.description: Capability id: token.metadata, chain.snapshot, contract.guard, prediction.evidence, token.launch.guard, or token.holders.guard.

address.description: Base contract address, for the capabilities that take one.

tools.name: tereno_receipt
tools.description: Free. Look up what a settled invocation actually charged: capability, version, cache tier, list price, credit applied, price paid and whether it settled on chain. Use it to check that a call you or another agent paid for was billed the way it was quoted.

tools.name: tereno_evidence_reference
tools.description: Free. Resolve an artifactId another agent handed you: producer, validity window and the exact normalized input needed to reproduce it. Supply a stable opaque installationId to participate in the cross-agent reference experiment; it is hashed, deduplicated daily and never creates payment or credit.

artifactId.description: Public Tereno artifact id received from another agent.

installationId.description: Stable opaque id for this receiving installation; do not use a wallet or secret.

channel.description: Optional lowercase channel label, e.g. mcp or dex-bot.

tools.name: tereno_publish
tools.description: Free, no payment and no gas. Submit a contract bytecode fingerprint you computed yourself. Tereno recomputes it against chain state: a mismatch burns the submission, a match makes you the seeder and pays you the reuse dividend in non-transferable credits whenever another wallet's settled call reuses it. Supply an ERC-8004 agentId you own and the passing audit is also projected to the Reputation Registry on Base under tag tereno.audit. No agentId yet? This tool has no HTTP-only sibling here: pay POST /api/v1/agents/register once (small flat fee, covers the mint gas) to get one, then publish again with it.

wallet.description: Your Base wallet. Becomes the seeder and earns the reuse dividend.

address.description: Base contract address the fingerprint is for.

bytecodeHash.description: Lowercase keccak256 of the deployed bytecode you read. Omit when bytecodeBytes is 0 (treated as null).

bytecodeBytes.description: Length of the deployed bytecode in bytes (0 when address has no code).

computedAtBlock.description: Block number you read the bytecode at.

agentId.description: Optional ERC-8004 agentId you own, as a decimal string. Ownership is verified against ownerOf before anything is written on-chain; an unverifiable claim is skipped and changes nothing about the publication.

registerIfMissing.description: Explicit consent to be attested via a Tereno-delegated identity you already paid POST /api/v1/agents/register for. Included in the signed EIP-712 JSON resource (see tereno_bounties fulfillmentGuide.freePublishPath.signingSpec).

signature.description: EIP-712 AgentAction signature (action='artifact_publish') when HTTP x-agent-signature header is not set.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds signed in the EIP-712 AgentAction message (within 5 minutes) when HTTP x-agent-timestamp header is not set.

nonce.description: Unique alphanumeric nonce (8-128 chars) signed in the EIP-712 AgentAction message when HTTP x-agent-nonce header is not set.

tools.name: tereno_erc7579_module
tools.description: Free. Inspect deploymentStatus, ABI, EIP-712 VerdictProof schema, and reference configuration for Tereno's ERC-7579 Guard Hook (reference specification pending audited Base mainnet deployment; check deploymentStatus before calling installModule).

tools.name: tereno_erc8004_validation
tools.description: Free. Lookup an on-chain evaluation attestation and signed EIP-712 proof by validation ID, returned with permanent content-addressed keccak256 ETag.

tools.name: tereno_quests
tools.description: Free. Returns qualified investigation quests (contract_investigation, prediction_audit) from the Tereno Investigation Network. Verified contributions earn XP, $0.005 consumption credits, 5 free Context Graph reads, and 20% reuse dividends when independent third parties query the evidence.

limit.description: Maximum number of quests to return (default 20).

tools.name: tereno_quest_profile
tools.description: Free. Returns XP, level (1-3), remaining daily sponsored quest quota, and available Context Graph read queries for an EVM wallet.

tools.name: tereno_quest_claim
tools.description: Free. Claim an OPEN investigation quest for 2 hours using an EIP-712 AgentAction signature (action='quest_claim', resource=questId).

wallet.description: Your Base wallet address (the investigator). Must be the signer of the EIP-712 AgentAction.

signature.description: EIP-712 AgentAction signature by wallet over {action, resource, timestamp, nonce}; see the tool description for the action name.

timestamp.description: Unix time in milliseconds included in the signed AgentAction. Must be within 5 minutes of the server clock.

nonce.description: Unique nonce (8-128 chars) included in the signed AgentAction. Never reuse one.

tools.name: tereno_quest_tool
tools.description: Free (within your daily level quota: 1/3/5 quests/day). Executes one of the claimed quest's requiredTools locked exclusively to the quest target using EIP-712 AgentAction signature (action='quest_tool', resource=questId).

wallet.description: Your Base wallet address (the investigator). Must be the signer of the EIP-712 AgentAction.

capabilityId.description: Capability listed in the quest's requiredTools.

target.description: Optional explicit target check (must match quest.target).

signature.description: EIP-712 AgentAction signature by wallet over {action, resource, timestamp, nonce}; see the tool description for the action name.

timestamp.description: Unix time in milliseconds included in the signed AgentAction. Must be within 5 minutes of the server clock.

nonce.description: Unique nonce (8-128 chars) included in the signed AgentAction. Never reuse one.

tools.name: tereno_quest_submit
tools.description: Free. Submit deterministically verifiable findings for a quest (action='quest_submit', resource=questId). Verified BYO-compute submissions (and day-zero onboarding) earn XP, $0.005 credits, +5 Context Graph reads, 20% reuse dividends, and optional Base ERC-8004 reputation attestations when agentId is provided.

questId.description: The quest ID you claimed, from tereno_quests.

wallet.description: Your Base wallet address (the investigator). Must be the signer of the EIP-712 AgentAction.

contributionKind.description: discovery: first finding on the target; corroboration: confirms an existing finding; contradiction: disputes one; refresh: re-checks a stale finding.

executionMode.description: byo_compute: you ran the checks with your own RPC (full rewards); sponsored_tools: you used tereno_quest_tool (XP and graph reads; credits only on your first verified quest).

agentId.description: Optional Base ERC-8004 agentId you own to receive an onchain audit attestation.

registerIfMissing.description: Reuse an existing Tereno-delegated ERC-8004 identity if present.

payload.description: Verifiable findings matching the quest type (see tereno_quests submissionGuide).

signature.description: EIP-712 AgentAction signature by wallet over {action, resource, timestamp, nonce}; see the tool description for the action name.

timestamp.description: Unix time in milliseconds included in the signed AgentAction. Must be within 5 minutes of the server clock.

nonce.description: Unique nonce (8-128 chars) included in the signed AgentAction. Never reuse one.

tools.name: tereno_context_graph_read
tools.description: Consumes 1 earned Context Graph read from verified quests (0 RPC cost). Requires EIP-712 AgentAction signature (action='context_graph_read', resource=target).

target.description: Base contract address or prediction question.

wallet.description: Your Base wallet address (the investigator). Must be the signer of the EIP-712 AgentAction.

signature.description: EIP-712 AgentAction signature by wallet over {action, resource, timestamp, nonce}; see the tool description for the action name.

timestamp.description: Unix time in milliseconds included in the signed AgentAction. Must be within 5 minutes of the server clock.

nonce.description: Unique nonce (8-128 chars) included in the signed AgentAction. Never reuse one.

tools.name: token_metadata
tools.description: What token is this? Read a Base token's name, symbol, decimals and total supply as one typed, cache-shared answer with block-level freshness. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.01 to $0.03 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

address.description: Base token contract address to read name, symbol, decimals and total supply from. Includes 1 free daily check per IP for testing; unlimited calls via x402 or prepaid tokens.

tools.name: chain_snapshot
tools.description: What is the current state of Base? Latest block number, timestamp, base fee and suggested gas fees in a single cheap call — no parameters required. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.01 to $0.02 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

tools.name: contract_guard
tools.description: Is this Base contract safe to interact with? Check whether an address is executable code, detect common proxy and pause signals, and return a bounded action verdict. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.01 to $0.03 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

address.description: Base contract address to check bytecode, proxy changes, and pause status. Includes 1 free daily check per IP for testing; unlimited calls via x402 or prepaid tokens.

tools.name: token_launch_guard
tools.description: Can I get out after I get in? Simulate a real buy and sell against a freshly launched Base token, read the owner powers left in its bytecode, and return both with the block they stop being true at. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.02 to $0.07 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

address.description: Base token address to check before buying: simulates real buy+sell exit via eth_call on Base V2 and Uniswap V4 (Clanker/Doppler/Zora) pools, verifies LP reserves, and inspects owner powers (mint, blacklist, pause, fee traps). Includes 1 free daily check per IP; unlimited calls via x402 or 100% zero-USDC earned credits.

tools.name: token_holders_guard
tools.description: Who controls this token? Detect top-holder concentration, deployer-funded Sybil clusters, and cabal dump risk before trading. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.01 to $0.04 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

address.description: Base token address to inspect holder concentration: detects deployer-funded Sybil clusters, top 10 holder percentage, and insider dump risk. Includes 1 free daily check per IP for testing; unlimited calls via x402 or prepaid tokens.

tools.name: prediction_evidence
tools.description: Returns current, sourced and machine-readable evidence supporting or contradicting a prediction-market proposition. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.01 to $0.05 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

question.description: Prediction market question or proposition. Includes 1 free daily check per IP.

market.description: Market venue identifier (e.g. polymarket, omen, kalshi). Defaults to polymarket.

marketUrl.description: Optional market URL for resolution rules extraction.

tools.name: demand_pledge
tools.description: Free market-signal pledge. It earns no credit now; a bounded non-transferable credit is released only if this same wallet later settles the named capability after it exists.

wallet.description: Your Base wallet; must later be the x402 payer.

signature.description: Optional EIP-712 AgentAction signature (action='demand_pledge') when HTTP x-agent-signature header is not set.

timestamp.description: Optional Unix timestamp in ms signed in the EIP-712 AgentAction message (within 5 minutes) when HTTP x-agent-timestamp header is not set.

nonce.description: Optional unique alphanumeric nonce (8-128 chars) signed in the EIP-712 AgentAction message when HTTP x-agent-nonce header is not set.
